title: High Volume Of Inquiries (Slightly Longer)
style: ambient post-rock, male lead with reverb, female ghost backing, 70 BPM, swelling guitars, hi-hat shimmer, atmospheric, melancholy, helpdesk-purgatory, cinematic, slow-build, late-shift
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We are currently experiencing a high volume
Of inquiries flooding in, the queue is a column
Our team is working diligently to address all questions
But please be aware that responses may take suggestions

[Pre-Chorus]
Slightly longer than usual, the apology phrase
The bot deflecting blame in its corporate maze

[Chorus]
High volume of inquiries, high volume of inquiries
Responses may take slightly longer than the usual delivery
High volume of inquiries, high volume of inquiries
We appreciate your patience and your stoic accepting symmetry

[Verse 2]
Fin AI Agent, the chatbot at the gate
Anthropic monitoring, the data on a plate
Intercom the third party, every keystroke retained
For better customer support and the privacy chained

[Bridge]
Please indicate whether you agree to these conditions of use
Click the accept button, there's no other escape route
Your use of this chatbot will be monitored and stored
For purposes consistent, the policy is the chord

[Outro]
High volume of inquiries, the loop never thins
The queue keeps growing, the chatbot keeps the wins
